schedule.default_mode: Static provenance, cadence, and due-date validation. Live upstream checks should be added only when a source-specific adapter can avoid brittle false positives.

validation_lanes.method: JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and generated artifact validation in CI
Release manifest checksums, immutable release URLs, and generated artifact drift detection
Layer-specific bounds, ranking direction, confidence interval, source vintage, and impossible-unit checks
Evidence-kind, caveat, uncertainty, source-vintage, and review-status visibility before publish

sources.label: Welfare Footprint event estimates
sources.freshness_basis: Welfare Footprint public reports and charts are reviewed on publication cycles and at least quarterly for the event evidence catalog.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when new reviewed event evidence or changed source attribution should alter the public catalog.

sources.label: Our World in Data livestock and animal production tables
sources.source_vintage: Latest public runtime rows where available; frozen release values dated 2026-05-31.
sources.freshness_basis: OWID animal-production rows can change independently of immutable PainMap releases, so runtime overlay assumptions need weekly freshness checks.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when frozen animal-production proxy rows should be rematerialized into a new release.

sources.label: Fishcount-style aquaculture and farmed-fish context
sources.freshness_basis: Fishcount-style aquaculture assumptions are reviewed monthly because they are secondary inputs to individual-animal count proxies.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when fish-count assumptions or attribution notes change canonical proxy rows.

sources.label: World Bank country indicators
sources.freshness_basis: World Bank country indicators are checked monthly and rematerialized only through release artifacts.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when latest non-null country indicators change frozen human-burden proxy rows.

sources.label: World Bank Global Subnational Poverty Atlas ADM1 poverty context
sources.source_vintage: 2023 ADM1 lineup with 2021 PPP poverty-context values
sources.freshness_basis: GSAP ADM1 poverty-context rows are static discovery overlays and should be reviewed quarterly or when World Bank publishes a new lineup.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when ADM1 context rows, source vintage, or static page priorities change.

sources.label: World Bank land-area context
sources.freshness_basis: Land-area context is slow moving, but still affects wild-animal and insect proxy context.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when land-area context changes proxy calculations or attribution notes.

sources.label: Natural Earth Admin 0 countries
sources.freshness_basis: Natural Earth country boundaries are vendored and should advance only through controlled release review.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when vendored Admin 0 boundaries or geometry simplification outputs change.

sources.label: geoBoundaries ADM1
sources.source_vintage: Runtime current ADM1 API, converted to media.githubusercontent.com when needed
sources.freshness_basis: geoBoundaries ADM1 can update independently, so the runtime/current boundary posture needs monthly review.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when ADM1 boundary source behavior or partitioned geometry outputs change.

sources.label: PainMap welfare and normalization assumptions
sources.freshness_basis: PainMap welfare assumptions need explicit editorial review before they affect visible rankings.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when method notes, welfare-range assumptions, or caveats change.

sources.label: PainMap priority overlay review
sources.freshness_basis: Priority overlays should change only when the review logic is rerun and documented in release notes.
sources.release_candidate_action: Open a release-candidate PR when priority overlay logic, source salience, or ranking notes change.
